Title: Relates to the crime of promoting an obscene sexual performance by a child
Summary: Includes the act of, when knowing the character and content thereof, a person produces, directs or promotes any obscene synthetic sexual performance, as committing the crime of promoting an obscene sexual performance by a child; defines "obscene synthetic sexual performance".
ActClause: AN ACT to amend the penal law, in relation to the crime of promoting an obscene sexual performance by a child
